_comment: BC-35 — mutation testing SCOPED to the two safety files only. 100% branch coverage proves the lines RAN; this proves a wrong rule would be CAUGHT (flip > to >= on the ACWR threshold and a test must fail). Full-repo mutation is too slow for the gate, so this runs as its own CI job.
_comment_mutator: excludedMutations: reason strings are supportive-coach UX copy, not injury-safety rules — mutating them is no safety risk, so they're a justified ignore. Every behaviour-changing mutator (operators, conditionals, arithmetic) is still tested.
_comment_thresholds: Current score ~90% (loadMetrics 95%, adaptation ~88%). break=88 leaves margin so the single timeout-killed mutant flipping on a faster CI runner can't flake the gate. Ratchet UP as survivors are killed; never lower.
